integrity: Complete standalone Python standard-library checker embedded; exact rational arithmetic and full Prüfer enumeration up to seven vertices; same-model review only, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent homogeneous-edge final-size infection model on finite undirected trees; pairwise rather than global optimal-source ranking. Seven-vertex cutoff and two-class census computer-aided with exact arithmetic. Earlier general existence theorem is acknowledged. Full text of one plausible older paper inaccessible; historical novelty provisional.
title: Seven vertices are sharp for transmissibility-dependent epidemic-source ranking reversals on trees
